definitions.explanation: A pattern of parallel lines or bands, as on cloth, an animal's coat, or any surface. Most often used of textiles and clothing.

examples.japanese: {縞|しま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。

⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縞|しま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{細|ほそ}く→細い：02962_hosoi⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: Vertical stripes are said to have a slimming effect.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{縞|しま}{模様|もよう}→縞模様：26237_shimamoyou⟧: striped pattern
- ⟦{縦縞|たてじま}→縦縞：18811_tatejima⟧: vertical stripes
- ⟦{横縞|よこじま}→横縞：18812_yokojima⟧: horizontal stripes
- {縞|しま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: striped (modifying a noun)

NOTE: Often combines with a direction or pattern word: ⟦{縦縞|たてじま}→縦縞：18811_tatejima⟧, ⟦{横縞|よこじま}→横縞：18812_yokojima⟧, ⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧{縞|しま} (wide stripes). The homophone ⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧ (00885) means island.
